encounters.name: Underwrite Collector
encounters.description: An Underwrite collector waits by the gate with a bound ledger. Polite, procedural, exactly as threatening as the contract terms say and no more.

choices.text: Produce the signed voucher copy and clear the day's interest.
choices.result: The collector crosses the line out in purple ink, gives a low nod, and moves on.

choices.text: Refuse to open the ledger.
choices.result: The collector makes a single neat marginal mark and promises a visit to the Lockup.

encounters.name: Backer Pressure
encounters.description: A veteran stall-holder leans over the counter. She is willing to stand behind your ruling at the next Standing, but she wants a crate of salt first.

choices.text: Hand over the salt to secure her voice.
choices.result: She pockets the token and promises her hand will be in the air when the quorum is called.

choices.text: Argue the principle of the matter without paying.
choices.result: She shrugs. Principles do not preserve winter meat.

encounters.name: Collateral Escort
encounters.description: Two heavies in salt-stained coats stand outside the Lockup gate. They are guarding forfeited goods under an active Underwrite lien.

choices.text: Show the formal redemption note.
choices.result: They step aside without a word. The chain rattles loose.

choices.text: Back away slowly.
choices.result: No one pursues. The contract holds its ground.

encounters.name: Iron Raiders Scout
encounters.description: A scout in hammered sheet steel perches on the viaduct approach, watching the gate with binoculars. They do not cross the survey seam.

choices.text: Hold ground under the Scale's neutral banner.
choices.result: The scout observes the disciplined guard shift, makes a notation, and melts into the dust.

encounters.name: Deserter Coalition Safe Passage
encounters.description: A pair of exhausted deserters ask for two days of uninspected passage through the Crossing under Compact escort.

choices.text: Grant them shelter under the Compact annex rubric.
choices.result: Perrin Ashby stamps their transient pass. The Garrison detachment on the ridge takes note.

choices.text: Turn them back to protect Crossing neutrality.
choices.result: They leave quietly into the ash. Osran approves of the caution.

encounters.name: Scavenger Dispute
encounters.description: A blacklisted scrap merchant tries to trade uncertified brass at Stallrow. Osran Kell steps up to inspect the mark.

choices.text: Back Osran's calibration test with the True Weight.
choices.result: The scale drops true. The rogue merchant is escorted out without violence.

choices.text: Let the crowd settle the weight.
choices.result: A shouting match erupts, lowering Stallrow trade trust for the week.

encounters.name: Grain Exchange Envoy
encounters.description: An envoy from the Central Grain Exchange arrives to ask why the Crossing maintains its own independent weighbridge without sending a delegate to the Board.

choices.text: Quote the charter rubric: 'No Power is in the room.'
choices.result: The envoy smiles thinly, records the defiance, and withdraws to report to the board.

encounters.name: Sun-Seekers Caravan Passage
encounters.description: A small convoy of Sun-Seekers in mirrored goggles passes through during a False Spring window, trading tinted glass for potable water.

choices.text: Trade clean water for their optical filters.
choices.result: The exchange is completed quickly. The convoy rolls westward into the sun.

encounters.name: The Public Forfeit
encounters.description: A debtor's granary keys are surrendered at noon in front of the assembled stallholders. Dessa Vane reads the receipt aloud twice.

choices.text: Stand in the crowd and witness the reading.
choices.result: No voice is raised. The procedure is cold, clear, and undisputed.

encounters.name: Standing Ambush
encounters.description: A rival faction attempts to flood the Standing with last-minute proxy voters to overturn an arbitration ruling.

choices.text: Spend your gathered Favour Tokens to call the honest quorum.
choices.result: The authentic backers step forward. The quorum holds firm and the hijack fails.

encounters.name: Mass Crossing Surge
encounters.description: Hundreds of displaced refugees from the southern suburbs gather outside the heavy gate, clamoring for passage before the ash storm hits.

choices.text: Deploy fire hoses and non-lethal deterrents to maintain order.
choices.result: The crowd retreats to the staging ditches, grumbling but orderly.

choices.text: Open the side wicket and process women and injured first.
choices.result: Fifty vulnerable refugees are sheltered safely in the lower arcade.

encounters.name: Garrison Armored Blockade
encounters.description: An armored half-track from the Central Garrison parks across the approach road, mounting a heavy machine gun and demanding search rights.

choices.text: Present the formal Charter Demarcation Treaty bearing garrison stamps.
choices.result: The commander checks the wax seal and orders his crew to withdraw.

choices.text: Pay a transit indemnity of forty rounds of rifle ammunition.
choices.result: The armored car shifts into reverse and clears the highway lane.

encounters.name: Pestilence Quarantine Standoff
encounters.description: A yellow quarantine banner has been hoisted over the bazaar following three deaths from lung-rot. Armed market guards block all exit points.

choices.text: Distribute respirator filters and carbolic disinfectant to stallholders.
choices.result: The panic subsides as systematic disinfection begins.

choices.text: Force a passage through the southern barrier with weapons drawn.
choices.result: You break through the cordon, but market reputation is severely damaged.

encounters.name: The Under-the-Table Voucher
encounters.description: A syndicate broker in a tailored wool coat offers a leather pouch containing twenty litres of refined diesel fuel to overlook an uninspected munitions crate.

choices.text: Reject the bribe and order immediate inspection of the contraband.
choices.result: The broker curses, but the munitions are cataloged into the public armory.

choices.text: Accept the fuel and sign the transit manifest without opening the crate.
choices.result: The heavy crate rolls through unchecked. Your fuel tanks are filled.

encounters.name: Bonded Caravan Ambush
encounters.description: A bonded caravan has stopped beneath the Scalehouse awning. Two guards are down, the cargo seals are intact, and the attackers are arguing over whether the Crossing's bond makes the goods valuable or dangerous to touch.

choices.text: Stand with the caravan and preserve the sealed cargo.
choices.result: The blank manifest becomes a witness record. The attackers withdraw before the cargo seal is broken.

choices.text: Offer a measured share to get the road open.
choices.result: The convoy moves again, but the first broken seal becomes an argument at the next Standing.

choices.text: Record the breach and leave the claim to the Crossing.
choices.result: You leave the cargo untouched. The Scale receives a precise account and a difficult responsibility.

encounters.name: Smuggler Checkpoint
encounters.description: An improvised barrier blocks the unmarked road below the Watchtower. The people holding it call the payment a road fee; the charter has no record of the road or the fee.

choices.text: Pay the fee and keep the convoy moving.
choices.result: The barrier opens. The receipt is new, but the authority it claims is not.

choices.text: Ask the Watchtower to test the checkpoint's jurisdiction.
choices.result: The watch records both names and orders the barrier lowered until the claim is heard.

choices.text: Turn back before an unofficial toll becomes a recognized one.
choices.result: The road remains closed to you, and the checkpoint keeps collecting from those with less time.

encounters.name: Frozen Barge
encounters.description: A cargo barge has frozen into the Drown's edge below the viaduct. Its manifest is locked in the cabin, the crew are gone, and three different claim marks have already appeared on the hull.

choices.text: Secure the manifest and ask the Records Room to hold the claim.
choices.result: The cargo stays sealed while the first legible claim is copied into the Crossing record.

choices.text: Take only the supplies needed to free the route.
choices.result: The passage clears, but every claimant can point to the moment the seal was disturbed.

choices.text: Leave the barge frozen and move the convoy around it.
choices.result: No property changes hands. The ice and the claims remain in place for whoever comes next.

encounters.name: Toll Bridge Claim
encounters.description: A faction crew has raised a barrier across the Deck Scale approach, calling common passage a maintained service. Their receipt book is new. Their rifles are not.

choices.text: Pay the toll and keep the crossing from becoming a firefight.
choices.result: The barrier lifts. The payment buys safety and gives the new toll a history.

choices.text: Present the charter pages and demand the common route remain open.
choices.result: The crew reads the clause twice. Nobody agrees what it means, but the rifles lower for now.

choices.text: Take the longer approach and leave the claim untested.
choices.result: Your cargo arrives late. The bridge crew keeps calling the delay proof that their toll is necessary.

encounters.name: Collapsed Crossing
encounters.description: A section of the approach has fallen away, leaving a narrow span built from doors and cable. Someone has chalked load limits on both sides, and the numbers do not agree.

choices.text: Cross one load at a time under the Watchtower's count.
choices.result: The span holds. The watch records the load order as a temporary rule.

choices.text: Stop and ask the Crossing to close the route until it is reinforced.
choices.result: The road goes quiet. Traders complain, but nobody has to explain a second collapse.

choices.text: Let another convoy test the chalked limit first.
choices.result: You keep your people back. The route remains open in theory and less trustworthy in practice.

encounters.name: Contaminated Ford
encounters.description: Oily residue clings to the water casks arriving at the Scalehouse. A trader insists the contamination is old; the loading crew wants the next convoy cleared before the source is named.

choices.text: Hold the casks and enter the discrepancy in the load record.
choices.result: The cargo waits under seal. The argument moves from rumor to a page that can be read by everyone.

choices.text: Accept the trader's assurance and keep the route open.
choices.result: The convoy leaves on time. If the residue was fresh, the record will show who chose speed.

choices.text: Reroute around the ford and warn the next carrier.
choices.result: The safer route costs a day. The warning travels farther than the original claim.

encounters.name: Ice Fracture
encounters.description: The ice gives a low cracking report beneath the first loaded sled at the viaduct approach. The shortest route stays straight ahead; the safer bank adds hours and exposes the convoy to the wind.

choices.text: Unload and shuttle the cargo across in smaller weights.
choices.result: The crossing takes longer, but the manifest survives with every seal accounted for.

choices.text: Take the bank route and accept the lost daylight.
choices.result: The convoy arrives late and intact. Nobody calls the detour wasteful after dark.

choices.text: Continue straight with only the lightest loads aboard.
choices.result: The route holds for now. The next convoy will not be able to say it was unwarned.

encounters.name: Uncleared Field
encounters.description: Old warning stakes emerge from the snow around the Founders' Marker. Beyond them, disturbed ground and one half-buried casing suggest the approach was never cleared.

choices.text: Backtrack and mark the approach closed.
choices.result: The route costs time, but the warning stakes gain a fresh line in the Crossing record.

choices.text: Follow the old marked line without leaving it.
choices.result: The convoy passes one careful step at a time. The safe line becomes a fragile piece of shared knowledge.

choices.text: Send no one into the field and wait for another route.
choices.result: The crossing is abandoned for the day. Nothing is gained except the chance to try again alive.

encounters.name: Refugee Blockade
encounters.description: A group denied immediate admission has stopped carts outside the Petition Tent and refuses to clear the road until someone from the Crossing hears their request.

choices.text: Hear the petition before asking the carts to move.
choices.result: The road stays blocked, but the names and needs in the petition become part of the public record.

choices.text: Offer a temporary place in the Annex under a named sponsor.
choices.result: The carts clear one lane. The sponsor accepts a duty that can be read back later.

choices.text: Enforce the road's passage and leave admission to the next assembly.
choices.result: The route opens by order. The petition remains, and so does the grievance.

encounters.name: Family at the Ledger Gate
encounters.description: A family presents an admission chit issued months ago by a sponsor who is now missing. The gate clerk calls the paper valid; the ration office says the absent sponsor voids the obligation.

choices.text: Honor the chit under the household named on it.
choices.result: The family receives a place in the Annex. The ledger gains an obligation no office can pretend not to see.

choices.text: Require a new sponsor before entry.
choices.result: The paper remains intact, but the family waits outside the rule it was meant to invoke.

choices.text: Grant temporary entry while the Records Room verifies the claim.
choices.result: The family gets a night indoors. Tomorrow's ruling will decide whether the temporary measure becomes a precedent.

encounters.name: Child at the Gate
encounters.description: A child arrives alone with an adult's charter token and a surname the gate clerk recognizes. No guardian follows, and the token belongs to a household that has not drawn rations in weeks.

choices.text: Admit the child under the old household record.
choices.result: The gate honors the name before anyone can prove what happened to the household behind it.

choices.text: Hold the child in the Annex while the Records Room checks the token.
choices.result: The child is safe for the night. The Crossing must decide whether verification is protection or delay.

choices.text: Seek a current sponsor before opening the gate.
choices.result: The request moves through the Petition Tent. The token remains a claim, not yet an admission.

crises.name: Wyn's Granary Forfeit
crises.description: The Underwrite moves to seize the community granary unless the debt is paid or renegotiated.
crises.resolution: Debt honoured or fairly renegotiated through arbitration.

crises.name: Draft Four Ratification
crises.description: The Compact brings the revised charter rubric to an open assembly vote.
crises.resolution: Clean or contested ratification by majority show of hands.

crises.name: The Contested Standing
crises.description: A high-stakes trade arbitration is challenged by a bloc claiming corrupted calibration.
crises.resolution: Ruling holds or is honestly overturned through verified weights.

crises.name: Three Dry Pages Discovered
crises.description: The original pre-war charter pages are recovered from the Records Room archive.
crises.resolution: The truth of the crossing is revealed to all three blocs.

crises.name: Who Holds the Ledger
crises.description: The final confrontation determining whether Scale, Underwrite, Compact, or Collapse governs Sector 4.
crises.resolution: One of four canonical faction resolutions is established.

crises.name: The Water Claim
crises.description: A maintenance bloc claims that keeping the Crossing's water source working gives it the right to control access. Others answer that common water is written into the charter because nobody survives a private monopoly.
crises.resolution: The dispute is settled through the existing arbitration path: common access, a maintenance concession, or a publicly recorded usage rule.

crises.name: The Grain Riot
crises.description: Grain deliveries fall behind ration promises, and the warehouse inventory no longer matches the public ledger. The crowd outside wants the doors opened before an audit can finish.
crises.resolution: An existing vote, arbitration, or forfeit path determines whether the grain is distributed, held for proof, or seized under a recorded obligation.

crises.name: The Charter Amendment
crises.description: A bloc proposes narrowing charter protection for residents it calls temporary. The amendment is legal enough to reach the floor, which makes the argument more dangerous than an open threat.
crises.resolution: The existing Crossing vote path records a clean, contested, or failed amendment without creating a new charter-law interpreter.

crises.name: Debt Forgiveness
crises.description: A debtor bloc asks that emergency obligations from the last season be erased together. Creditors argue that forgiving them now means no one will extend supplies on promise again.
crises.resolution: Existing assembly or arbitration mechanics produce a recorded settlement, partial forfeit, or refusal; no new debt authority is implied.

crises.name: Refugee Admission
crises.description: A refugee group requests admission under the Crossing's nobody-owned charter. The claim is morally simple and administratively expensive: food, space, and names must be entered into systems already under strain.
crises.resolution: The existing vote or arbitration route records admission, sponsorship, or refusal without adding a refugee simulation.

crises.name: The Arbitrator Bribe
crises.description: Payment records suggest an arbitrator received supplies from one side of a pending claim. The arbitrator says the transfer was repayment of an older debt and asks to remain seated.
crises.resolution: Existing arbitration and backer mechanics determine whether the ruling is held, challenged, or re-called; no tribunal subsystem is introduced.

crises.name: The Quarantine Break
crises.description: A resident leaves quarantine before clearance and spends several hours near the market district. The medical question is urgent; the civic question begins when people ask whether the resident still has charter protection.
crises.resolution: The existing Crossing political path records containment and reintegration decisions; disease state remains owned by the active disease system.
